title: End-of-unit quiz: skeletons, nutrition and plants
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Seeded from science/y3 lesson 24 (End-of-unit quiz: skeletons, nutrition and plants (portal worksheet with answer key))
intro: Covers lessons 1 to 24 of Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales). Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Which part makes food for the plant?
questions.a: B) Leaf. The leaf uses sunlight to make food. Roots take in water; flowers make seeds.

questions.q: Testing light: what must stay the same?
questions.a: A) The amount of water. We change only the light; water, seeds and pots stay the same.

questions.q: Where will the colour show first?
options: Inside the stem near the bottom
questions.a: B) Inside the stem near the bottom. The water goes up from the bottom, so the stem near the water colours first.

questions.q: Which food is mostly protein?
questions.a: B) Eggs. Eggs are protein for growth; rice is carbohydrate; an apple gives vitamins.

questions.q: Which bones protect your heart?
questions.a: B) Ribs. The ribs make a cage round the heart and lungs; the skull protects the brain.

questions.q: When you bend your arm, the biceps...
questions.a: A) Contracts. The biceps gets shorter (contracts) to pull the arm up. Muscles never push.

questions.q: Which animal is an invertebrate?
questions.a: B) Beetle. A beetle has an exoskeleton but no backbone. Sharks and pigeons have backbones.

questions.q: Why might a plant have very big leaves?
questions.a: A) To catch more light. Big leaves catch more light to make food. Plants in shade often have big leaves.

questions.q: Pot 2 is in the dark. What are we testing with it?
questions.a: A) Light. Pot 2 has water and warmth but no light, so it tests light.

questions.q: Which is a conclusion?
options: Water travels up the stem in tubes
questions.a: B) Water travels up the stem in tubes. A conclusion says what the results show. The other two describe what we did or saw.

questions.q: Pot 2 grew tall but pale. What does it show?
options: Plants need light to be healthy and green
questions.a: B) Plants need light to be healthy and green. It grew tall searching for light but could not make food, so it was pale and weak.

questions.q: Which is a fair test?
questions.a: B) Change only the light. Only one thing changes in a fair test.

questions.q: Is a snail a vertebrate?
questions.a: No

questions.q: Which food group gives us energy?
questions.a: Carbohydrates

questions.q: The stem...
questions.a: Holds the plant up and carries water
options: Holds the plant up and carries water

questions.q: Which part takes in water?
questions.a: Root

questions.q: Which part makes food?
questions.a: Leaf

questions.q: In a fair test we change...
questions.a: One thing

questions.q: Which pot tests water in our cress test?
questions.a: Pot 3

questions.q: What does a fair test change?
questions.a: One thing
